proposed.text: An architect knows copyright protection exists by creation under RA 8293, but records copyright-related documents after dissemination or assignment. What is the source-safe purpose of that recording/deposit step?

options.text: It extends the copyright term beyond the statutory period
It creates an official record or notice for deposit, assignment, or exclusive license documents without making registration the source of copyright
It is the only way an architect can ever enforce a copyright claim
It gives the architect a monopoly over all similar building concepts

rationale.a: Recording or deposit does not extend the statutory term.
rationale.c: Section 172.2 contradicts the idea that registration is the source of copyright.
rationale.d: Copyright does not protect all similar concepts or functional ideas.
rationale.correct: RA 8293 Section 172.2 protects works by the sole fact of creation. Sections 182 and 191 address filing or deposit records for assignments, exclusive licenses, and disseminated works. Those record steps support documentation and notice; they do not create copyright, extend the term, or protect generic concepts.
rationale.takeaway: Recording supports evidence and notice; creation is the source of copyright protection under Section 172.2.
